description:
Si-yul, who had worked hard to save up a deposit for rent in order to leave the orphanage and live independently, was swindled out of his savings. To raise the money again, at the urging of his childhood friend from the orphanage, he is forced to take on a dangerous, high-paying part-time job delivering drugs.

As usual, Si-yul went to make a delivery to a club, only to be caught by Woo Hyun-se, the club’s owner, who was famous for his good looks. He begged for his life and narrowly escaped, but it wasn’t long before he was caught again; as if by a twist of fate, during their third encounter, he ended up owing him a huge debt.

*“You say you’ve got no money, so what else can I do? You’ll have to pay me back with your body.”*

It was a relationship that began with words that were half-threat, half-joke, but before they knew it, a strange chemistry began to develop between them…

*“What if I refuse?”  
“I suppose I’ll make things a bit more of a nuisance for you than they are now.” 
“Are you saying you’ll torment me?”  
“I’m saying we’ll see each other more often.”*

---
